findings: REJECTED: bounded serialization gains reproduce, but the fresh matrix has whole-output failures. All nine simple paired empty/body color cases pass after the change. Seven of nine composite cases pass; transparent and alpha 00 still emit an extra transparent path and incorrect divider positions. All nine concurrent cases fail (for example West UID ent0004 instead of Java ent0003) despite correct fill/opacity.

The 45 paired choice/fork/join/history/deep-history cases (nine colors each) are valid STATE Java diagrams but the shipped Rust CLI dispatches them as SEQUENCE. They are explicit T14.21 failures and cannot certify state-paint paths. This packet claims no correctness for the concurrent sequence packet. Earlier retained choice/history and empty-state failures remain failures.

OUT-OF-CLAIMED-SCOPE BEHAVIOR: resolve_pseudo_state_color delegates to the new fill resolver, but StateSkin::from_diagram still calls it for start_stroke and end_stroke at state.rs:2154/:2157. Fresh circle_root_rebecca changes circle strokes #663399 -> #FFFFFF; fresh circle_root_alpha also changes stroke hex casing. Pinned Java emits #FFFFFF for RebeccaPurple, so this improves the circle attributes rather than regressing them. The ordinary state/arrow stroke still disagrees and the whole output fails. Predraft state-paint invariant explicitly says Stroke unchanged.

Pinned Java flow is EntityImageStateCommon.applyColor -> ValueImpl.asColor -> HColorSet.getColorOrWhite, and Cluster.drawUState/ConcurrentStates -> shape drivers -> SvgGraphics.fillMe. Shared fill_attributes correctly serializes RGB with opacity on measured simple/composite/concurrent paints; no unexplained numeric constant or fixture-keyed branch was added.

Exact bypass census: 19 direct dynamic-looking fill template sites remain: 15 fixed NOTE_FILL/PSEUDO_COLOR/BAR_COLOR shape sites and four TEXT_COLOR sites in render_with_oracle (macro lines 6833 warning, 7083 scoped history marker, 7278 history, 7316 deep-history). TEXT_COLOR is derived from skin.text_color, so these are real text paint bypasses. Fixed literals/none and gradient stop-color are separately outside the variable shape-fill inventory. No remaining user-variable SHAPE fill bypass was found; upstream role selection/dispatch is not repaired by serialization.

Automatic background, gradients, logical font names and alias/metric coupling, warning chrome, stripes, plain/code, base-style composition, and sequence escaping remain explicitly failed dependencies. None is waived.
